items.claim: Over-trigger nudge measured in client px but applied in the overlay frame's px, so it lands wrong under a scale or zoom
items.note: The viewport clamp now uses the frame's visible region too.

items.claim: A placeholder or `mixed` list can't flip above its trigger
The RTL crossOffset is computed against the wrong edge, and the default `--wzl-select-align` is `left`
items.note: The default is now `start`, and `start`/`end` follow the text direction.

items.claim: The capture-phase pointerup swallow hides the opening release from the trigger's press
items.note: The trigger's press now ends with a `pointercancel` on the document. React Aria shows the trigger as pressed while the list is open on purpose (RAC `Select` passes `isPressed: state.isOpen`), so the visible symptom is a trigger still marked pressed after the list shuts. The test checks that.

items.claim: FitSizer reads a fragment of `SelectItem`s as one label
items.note: `ComboBox` shares `FitSizer`, so it is fixed too. A custom component that renders `SelectItem`s can't be read without rendering it, and stays unread.

items.claim: `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange` and `selectionMode` reach React Aria and override `selectedKey`
items.note: They are dropped from the type and stripped at run time. The changeset is `major`/`breaking`, because code that passed them no longer typechecks.

items.claim: Adding or removing `tooltip`/`shortcut` remounts the trigger and drops focus
items.note: `TriggerTooltip` now keeps the same wrapper either way.

items.claim: RTL list shifted sideways by the list/trigger width difference
items.note: duplicate of A's RTL finding, fixed 194b74afeb.

items.claim: A quick touch tap on the selected row right after opening is swallowed
items.note: `Press` records `pointerType`, and the guard skips touch, which React Aria opens on release.

items.claim: `data-align` is never cleared when the list loses its selected row while open
Option values `1` and `'1'` get the same React key
items.note: as a strict call. React Aria itself keys rendered rows by `String(id)`: with the kit's key changed, it still warned "two children with the same key". So a `Select` whose option values read the same as text now throws a `RangeError`, with no override. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

not fixed: `ButtonTooltip` (`packages/ui/src/components/Tooltip/buttonTooltip.tsx`) still returns the bare button when there is no tooltip content. So a `Button` whose tooltip comes or goes remounts the same way. It is outside this area, and its `Focusable` wrapper changes the button's props, so it needs its own pass.
